links.outcome: Reading level of LLM-simplified healthcare materials versus the recommended target level, and topic fidelity
links.effect: LLMs can approximate targeted reading levels, but outputs are inconsistent, with significant variability in reading level and deviation from the topic; deemed unsuitable for deployment.
links.quote: Our results indicate that while LLMs can approximate targeted reading levels, their outputs are inconsistent, with significant variability in reading level and deviation from the topic, making them unsuitable for deployment in healthcare settings.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluation of multiple LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4o, LLaMA-3, Mistral) for simplifying psychiatric healthcare materials to recommended reading levels.
